author: Whitewood, Peter
title: Subversion in the Red Army and the Military Purge of 1937-1938
notes: The archival case that the purge of the Soviet officer corps grew out of a long-standing perception that the Red Army was vulnerable to subversion, rather than out of a sudden decision in 1937. **Only the author's abstract could be read from here**, in the York St John repository record; the accepted-manuscript PDF is open access but its embedded subset fonts defeat text extraction, so the article itself was not read. Whitewood is quoted on this pack's forward causal link from his own abstract and from nothing else, and the link says so.
